title: Contraptionable Rails
description: Allows Create tracks to be assembled to Create mod Contraptions such as bearings, trains, and other moving objects.
body:
A small lightweight mod that removes the 'unmovability' of Create tracks (works with SnR!), curves work too.

Disclaimer: Trains do not work on these tracks, thats something for Loconautics.


Thank you Tesseract for feedback and help!
